notes.title: Silent Scream 2 Demo – Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We’re excited (and honestly a little nervous) to announce that the Silent Scream 2 demo is officially live on Steam!

This project has been a journey filled with passion, challenges, and tough decisions. While we couldn’t bring you the full game just yet, we’re releasing this demo as it stands—raw and unpolished, but very real.
Now, we need you. Play the demo, experience the world we’ve created, and share your thoughts. Your feedback and support will determine what happens next. If enough players want more, we’ll fight to continue development. If not, this may be where Silent Scream 2 ends.

Thank you for sharing this journey with us. Download the demo now on Steam, and let us know what you think![url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110516/135abffc71baef776ffc1b5bbda3bcd0bca91b77.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110516/87a423416c0d5f22bb9465cb965de25e3d6cd763.png[/img][/url]

Regards,
The Silent Scream 2 Team

notes.title: Silent Scream 2 – A Sudden Crossroads
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110516/fbd8bcf3d027fcc2a707e0df6b7296a8f252a268.png[/img]Hey everyone, [b]we need to be real with you for a second.[/b]

[b]Silent Scream 2[/b] has been a passion project from the start. We’ve poured everything we have into it—time, energy, and a whole lot of love for horror. But the truth is, we’ve hit a wall. We don’t have the budget to keep pushing forward, and right now, we have two choices: shelve it indefinitely or release it as is and let YOU decide what happens next.

So, that’s exactly what we’re doing. Silent Scream 2 is coming in its current state—raw, and imperfect, but filled with everything we’ve managed to build so far. If you play it, enjoy it, and want more, then maybe, just maybe, we’ll find a way to continue this nightmare together. But if this is where the journey ends, then at least we gave it everything we had.

Your support means everything. However, this plays out, we appreciate every single one of you. Stay tuned.
